fact: On 5 December 2024 the Trésorerie Générale du Royaume published tender 70/2024 for technical assistance to correct and develop the GID integrated expenditure management system in four lots (credit, revenue, expenditure, interfacing), with a deadline of 16 January 2025.
title: Technical assistance for the IT development of corrections and developments of the information system of integrated expenditure management (GID)
